# Harbor Ledger

Payments reconciliation at Northwind Freight. Owner: Dana Reyes.

## Numbers
- Month-end close went from 6 days to 2 days after the rollout.
- The service handled about 41,000 payments a month at peak.

## Notes
The hard part was matching bank lines to invoices when the reference text was missing. Dana built a scoring step for it and measured 97 percent exact matches on a frozen set of 500 payments.
